command.noPermission: %pre% &cYou don't have permission to do that.
command.disallowedSethome: %pre% &cSorry, you can't set a home in this world (%arg1).
command.disallowedHomeDestination: %pre% &cSorry, this world has been disabled for sethomes (%arg1).

sethome.invalidSender: %pre% &cYou have to be a player to set a home.
sethome.createdHome: %pre% &fSet your home to your current location.
sethome.createdNamedHome: %pre% &fCreated a home named &3%arg1&f at your current location.
sethome.noMoreHomes: %pre% &fYou can't set any more homes. Use /delhome <name> to remove a home. (Limit: &3%arg1&f)
sethome.nameAlreadyExists: %pre% &fYou already have a home with the name &3%arg1&f! Try again with a different name.
sethome.nonAlphanumeric: %pre% &fYour home name must be alphanumeric; try again with the name &3%arg2 &for choose a different one.
sethome.nonAlphanumericNoSuggestion: %pre% &fYour home name must be alphanumeric; please choose a different name.
sethome.unsafeLocation: %pre% &cYou can't set a home here because it's unsafe!

home.invalidSender: %pre% &cYou have to be a player to teleport to a home.
home.invalidHome: %pre% &fYou don't have a home named &3%arg1&f. Type &3/homes&f to see your homes.
home.invalidHomeOther: %pre% &3%arg2&f doesn't have a home named &3%arg1&f. Type &3/homes %arg2&f to see their homes.
home.unsafeTeleport: %pre% &cWarning: the destination location is unsafe! To confirm you want to teleport, quickly run the command again.
home.invalidWorld: %pre% &fThe world this home is in is currently unloaded or invalid.

homes.invalidSender: %pre% &cYou have to be a player to see homes.
homes.noHomes: %pre% &fYou don't have any homes set! Set one with &3/sethome <name>

delhome.invalidHome: %pre% &fYou don't have a home named &3%arg1&f. Type &3/homes&f to see your homes.
delhome.invalidHomeOther: %pre% &3%arg2&f doesn't have a home named &3%arg1&f. Type &3/homes %arg2&f to see their homes.
delhome.invalidSender: %pre% &cYou have to be a player to delete a home.

homesadmin.invalidSender: %pre% &cYou have to be a player to open the admin menu.

homes.title: %pre% &8Your homes
homes.createDescription: &7Sets a home at your current position
homes.createHint: &eClick and type the name in chat

createHome.prompt: %pre% &fType the name of your new home in chat. Type &3%arg1 &fto cancel.

editHome.title: %pre% &8Edit %arg1
editHome.renameHint: &eClick and type the new name in chat

renameHome.prompt: %pre% &fType the new name for &3%arg2 &fin chat. Type &3%arg1 &fto cancel.

conflictWarning.message: %pre% &cWARNING: Homes has detected a potential CONFLICT with Essentials or another plugin providing home commands. If you experience problems using home commands, change 'alternateCommandExecutor' from 'false' to 'true' in plugins/Homes/config.yml and run /homesadmin reload.
conflictWarning.hint: &7If you are not experiencing problems with home commands, you can hide this warning by setting 'showDetectedConflictWarning' to false in config.yml.
